data.name: Eila
data.gender_notes: Eila is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Eila is the goddess of abundance and prosperity. She is often depicted holding a bowl overflowing with grains or gold. Her name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'eela' meaning 'a flow' or 'a current'. Eila is a symbol of the continuous cycle of life and the abundance of nature. The name Eila carries the meaning “Goddess of abundance” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Eila usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of abundance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the flow of abundance and prosperity in life.
data.etymology: Eila belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of abundance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eila total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
